title: Hurricane Harvey Support
description: Nine airmen from Scott's 375th Aeromedical Evacuation Squadron deployed to assist in the Hurricane Harvey efforts by moving 1,800 patients to seven different hospitals.
keywords: Air Mobility Command, United States Transportation Command, Hurricane Harvey, Scot Air Force Base, Mobile Readiness, humanitarian
